title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: After Milestone C approval, the METOC portion of the Moriah Program will go into the Production and Deployment phase of the DAS.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah Program involves the integration of three emerging wind and meteorological systems into a single environmental conditions monitoring program that will apply new sensors, processors, and local area networks to provide a combined wind, meteorological, and oceanographic measuring and indicating system.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will present airfield and battlegroup decision-makers with a unified picture of the ever-changing atmospheric conditions around a ship or shore station.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: An operational and maintenance workload analysis indicates there will be no need to increase end-strength or change force structure in order to implement and support the Moriah Program.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Personnel in the existing USN ratings of Aerographer’s Mate (AG), Electronics Technician (ET), Quartermaster (QM), and Fire Controlman (FC) will perform system operation, and Interior Communications Electricians (IC) will perform maintenance.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: An Information System Technician (IT) will maintain network administration systems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: A contractor, in conjunction with NAVAIR (Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Lakehurst, New Jersey) will create the CBT that will be used on Navy ships and Navy and Marine Corps Air Stations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah Program will replace the wind speed and direction sensors and associated displays on all ships and United States Navy (USN) and United States

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: It will provide a single METOC sensor suite consistent across all ship types, and will include all required METOC observations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The sensor subsystem of Moriah will measure all METOC conditions including wind speed and direction, barometric pressure, air temperature, sea surface temperature, relative humidity, visibility, insolation (incoming solar radiation), and cloud height.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: These in situ (local) meteorological measurements will be used for calculations of vertical profile and evaporation ducts.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The sensors will provide data to the automated data acquisition, processing, and distribution subsystems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The data acquisition system will acquire data from its sensors and from interfaces with other data acquisition systems such as ship navigation systems, and provide formatted data to shipboard systems and off-board locations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The capability to store data will be provided in both readily accessible formats for a minimum of 24 hours and in an archived format for longer-term storage.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: For the METOC side of Moriah, DT and OT will occur aboard the USS Coronado (AGF-11) beginning in first quarter FY03.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: After completion of DT and OT, Technical Evaluation (TECHEVAL) and Operational Evaluation (OPEVAL) will follow.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Additional information on DT, OT, TECHEVAL, and OPEVAL will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah Wind System will replace the AN/UMQ-5 Wind Speed and Direction System installed at USN and USMC Air Stations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Wind Measuring and Indicating System (WMIS) installed on ships and the Moriah METOC will replace the Shipboard Environmental Assessment/Weapon System Performance (SEAWASP) system.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: For all ship types, Moriah will provide a combined wind, meteorological, and oceanographic measuring and indicating system of the environmental conditions around the ship and in the battlegroup.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will provide continuous data for display and direct digital or analog input to ship systems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will provide continuous output of the parameters measured by the sensors and processed by the Moriah central processor in standard units of measure as required by the end users (systems and people).

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: These units of measure and the algorithms or formulas used to convert base output data will be identified in

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will use open system architecture to reduce the integration effort of additional sensors.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will have the capability to select valid data and process that data to provide system performance parameters.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will be capable of providing data for storage on multimedia mass storage devices.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: These interfaces, including system nomenclature, location on ship, required data format, and required sampling frequency to meet user-defined update rates will be iterated in a separate interface specification document.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will provide multiple display types with different levels of capability to include stand-alone continuous sensor information, aircraft launch and recovery decision aids, and control functions and maintenance diagnostics.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Displays will be capable of displaying both digital and analog graphics and will be usable both during daylight and during nighttime reduced light conditions.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will be capable of outputting National Television Standard C for ship’s closed circuit television systems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: In addition to the above shipboard requirement, the sensor suites procured by the Moriah Program will also be used to satisfy shore-based installation requirements as a partial replacement for augmentation to the Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and as a replacement for the AN/UMQ-5 Wind Speed and Direction System.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The wind speed and direction subsystem of Moriah will satisfy the requirements to replace the AN/UMQ-5, as well as augmentation for end-of-runway requirements submitted by the Type Commanders where installation costs are not prohibitive.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Replacing the AN/UMQ-5 with Moriah will be advantageous in that it will allow all USN wind systems to be uniform, saving maintenance and procurement costs.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The new wind sensors will be mounted in approximately the same locations as the existing detectors (port, starboard, and forward) so that no revalidation of aircraft launch and recovery envelopes will be required.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Wind data (either synchro or digital) from all sensors will be routed to both Moriah processors. b.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Due to the safety of flight nature of these functions, it is planned that the core Moriah processing function will be executed within two self-checking central processing units. c.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: It will be used to transmit Moriah information to various displays throughout the ship.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: It is planned that each Moriah processor will connect to a separate ICAN Input-Output Controller (IOC) via Ethernet.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: However, only the processor designated as primary will be transmitting information to its respective IOC for distribution. d.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Multiple display types will be available to support the differing requirements of individual watch-stations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: All high-end displays will be connected to IOC local to their particular location via Ethernet.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: High-end displays will display information such as: true wind speed and direction, relative wind speed and direction, crosswind and/or headwind, ship’s speed and course, launch and recovery bulletins, fox corpen data1, limited meteorological data, etc.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Low-end displays will also be connected to local IOCs or directly to the Moriah processors via an RS-422 digital serial interface.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Low-end displays will display either relative wind speed and direction or crosswind and headwind information.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: As descriptive information becomes available, it will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah Program equipment will be introduced as new production equipment based upon the Moriah operational and support concepts, with heavy reliance on Non-Developmental Item (NDI), Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS), and 1 Fox corpen data was previously calculated on a slide-rule.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: In the Moriah system it will be calculated automatically and displayed.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will interface with other systems through designated circuits or local networks for data acquisition and display, where applicable.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Data rates and formats will be compatible with network interface requirements.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Interface Specification document will define the top-level interface requirements and will be updated as interfaces are added, changed, or deleted.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will be activated during all underway periods for 24 hours per day.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will be fully mission capable in all weather conditions (tropical to arctic), heavy seas with wave heights up to 20 feet, and wind speeds up to 125 knots.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah will continuously sample the environmental battle-space and will display this information, along with direct digital and synchro input to weapons systems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Additionally, the data will be archived and disseminated in Naval message format.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah Wind and METOC will both have a flexible open architecture.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Both will be modular in design and capable of being deployed in a variety of configurations that will address the specific requirements of each particular user community.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Personnel from the existing USN ratings Aerographer’s Mate (AG), Electronics Technician (ET), Quartermaster (QM), and Fire Controlman (FC) will perform operation; Interior Communications Electrician (IC) personnel will be the maintainers.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: An Information System Technician (IT) will be used to maintain the network.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah equipment will incorporate a self-contained diagnostic and Built-In Test (BIT) system, continuity or systems degradation alarms, redundant paths for continuous operations in a combat or damage control environment, and operator reconfiguration capability without impacting system operations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: At this time there is no indication that any change to these devices will significantly affect the Moriah maintenance concept.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Organizational level maintenance will be performed by USN IC and by USMC MOS 6493, Aviation Meteorological Equipment Technician personnel.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Organizational level maintenance will include self-contained diagnostic tests and BIT; if the unit is not working properly, the unit under test will be removed and replaced.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Preventive maintenance will consist of periodic checks, filter replacement, and corrosion control, and will be determined through Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Corrective maintenance will consist of self-contained diagnostic tests and BIT as required, with removal and replacement of defective units as necessary. b.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: No intermediate level maintenance will be required.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: All failed units will be returned to the vendor for repair or disposed of by ship’s force. c.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The vendor will provide depot level maintenance. d.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The vendor will provide interim maintenance. e.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: There will be no mandatory overhaul period required for the Moriah systems.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: There will be no increase in end-strength or change in force structure as a result of the Moriah Program.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah system will be activated during all underway periods for 24 hours per day.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah system will also be operated at USN and USMC Air Stations for 24 hours per day. c.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Operational and maintenance functions will be assigned to existing USN and USMC personnel at the activities receiving the Moriah system.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: A contractor, in conjunction with NAVAIR [Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Lakehurst (NAWCADLKE), New Jersey] will create Computer-Based Training (CBT) that will be used on Navy ships and USN and USMC Air Stations as Onboard Training to develop the skills of personnel operating and maintaining Moriah equipment.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: There will also be an introduction to the Moriah system included in the AG “A” School, USMC Weather Observer School, and USMC Weather Forecaster School by Navy Technical Training Unit (NTTU), Keesler Air Force Base (AFB), Biloxi, Mississippi. a.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Alteration Installation Teams (AIT), Voyage Repair Teams (VRT), and shipyard personnel will provide initial training during installation of the particular Moriah system.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Initial training for operators will be provided by AITs, VRTs, and shipyard personnel during Moriah equipment installation and checkout.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Initial training for maintainers will be provided by AITs, VRTs, and shipyard personnel during Moriah equipment installation and checkout.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Initial training will include: ° Test and check of the Moriah system ° BIT procedures ° Cleaning ° Filter changing ° Corrosion control ° Removal and replacement of the failed unit Initial training will be provided to USN IC personnel and USMC MOS 6493, Aviation Meteorological Equipment Technician.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: There will be no operator or maintainer follow-on training.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Fleet training requirements will be satisfied via onboard proficiency training as shown in Paragraph I, Onboard (In-Service) Training. c.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Proficiency training will be provided to operator and maintainer personnel as onboard training and beginning in FY04, via contractor-developed CBT.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: On-the-Job Training will also be provided as required to enhance the skills and knowledge of individuals.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Pending a decision, if Personnel Qualification Standards (PQS) will be required, it will be provided by the PQS Development Center.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: PQS requirement information will be updated in this NTSP, as it becomes available.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah Wind production systems integration and manufacturing contract will be a competitively awarded firm fixed price contract for the various production lots.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Using the systems performance specification, NAWCADLKE will award a contract to one production system contractor who will integrate, manufacture, and deliver Moriah production systems to the USN for shipboard installation.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Information on the Moriah Wind contract will be included in updates of this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The Moriah METOC production systems integration and manufacturing contract will be a competitively awarded firm fixed price contract for the various production lots.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Using the systems performance specification, SPAWARSYSCOM will award a contract to one production system contractor who will integrate, manufacture, and deliver Moriah production systems to the USN for shipboard installation.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Moriah METOC contract information will be included in future editions of this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Shipboard installation of the production systems will not be included in the production contract, but will be contracted separately for various sources, including AITs, VRTs, and shipyard personnel.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Interface Control Documents that identify the Moriah configuration and data interfaces for each ship class will be used as the basis for all installations.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: As more specific information becomes available, it will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Program documentation currently consists of: ° Moriah Operational Requirements Document ° Memorandum of Agreement for Moriah ° Acquisition Strategy for Moriah ° Minutes of the Moriah Preliminary Design Review (PDR) ° System Specification As additional documentation becomes available, it will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Technical documentation, including Maintenance Instruction Manuals, Maintenance Requirements Cards, User Logistic Support Summary, Integrated Logistic Support Plan, etc., will be provided by the contractor upon system installation and checkout.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The TMCR is outdated and will be revised prior to contract award.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: As additional technical data information becomes available, it will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Only Technical Training Equipment (TTE) will be required at the organizational maintenance level.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: An In-Service Engineering Agent will provide interim spare parts support as Moriah is provisioned into the Navy Supply System.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: A Human Systems Integration (HSI) program will be organized to achieve the effective integration of personnel factors into the design of the system.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The HSI effort will include, but not necessarily be limited to, active participation in the following three major interrelated areas of system development: analysis, design and development, and test and evaluation.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The RFP for Moriah Wind will be issued in FY02.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Within the Moriah program, the two sub-components will be on slightly different timelines.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Since Moriah Wind is advanced technology, it will be fielded first.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: The delivery schedule for Moriah Wind will be included in updates to this NTSP.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
text: Version 1 will be installed in Aircraft Carrier Nuclear (CVN), Helicopter Landing and Amphibious Aviation Assault Ship (LHA), Amphibious Assault Ship (Special Purpose) (LHD), and Amphibious Assault Ship (Dock) (LPD) ships.

title: NAVY TRAINING SYSTEM PLAN FOR THE MORIAH PROGRAM
